article.title: How a three.ws model is rendered, from a sentence to a lit, rigged character in your browser tab

cover.alt: The lighthouse keeper, a rigged three.ws character in a long yellow oilskin coat, navy knitted cap and black rubber boots, standing in the live glTF viewer under studio lighting

posts.text: A glTF file, Three.js and WebGL on the viewer's own GPU: no plugin, no video, no server drawing frames. That is how three.ws renders 3D, and the Article follows one rigged character through making, packing, loading, lighting and animating, with the embed code, the free checking tools, our partners and the roadmap.
